title: matricaria maritima var. nana
intro: Matricaria maritima var. nana, commonly known as Dwarf Sea Chamomile, is a small flowering plant belonging to the daisy family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Sea Chamomile are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. Further research is necessary to confirm the efficacy and safety of Dwarf Sea Chamomile for medicinal use, but its potential therapeutic applications make it an interesting subject for further study.
